title: GamesIndustry.biz HR 峰会聚焦“人与职场”，塑造游戏行业职场未来
content:
GamesIndustry.biz HR Summit reveals new People and Workplace focus, dedicated to shaping the future of games workplaces | GamesIndustry.biz

Read our editorial policy
.
This year's GamesIndustry.biz HR Summit,
returning to the Royal Institution on October 1
, will have a new focus on People and Workplaces, with a series of sessions featuring, and speaking to, both HR professionals and business leaders on what the modern games workplace needs to be in a time of ongoing turmoil in the industry.
Sasi Venables
Guided as always by feedback and comments from previous attendees, this year's event features a broader lineup of speakers and topics focused on practical, first-hand insights into the issues facing games businesses now, as well as how to build effective people strategies for the years ahead.
Games recruitment specialist Amiqus
has returned as headline sponsor.
Our first keynote speaker will be noted HR influencer Sasi Venables, founder of the HR Confidence Club, who'll be speaking on the
future of people leadership amid changing workplace expectations for people professionals
. Her session will give broad guidance into resilience and strategic thinking for HR staff in games businesses.
Venables has 25 years of industry experience specialising in diversity, equality, inclusion, culture, and employee relations, and is a CIPD Chartered Fellow with a master's degree in Human Resource Management. Her work with the HR Confidence Club is dedicated to researching and delivering structured and reflective development experiences that help to articulate the value of HR, rebuild confidence, set boundaries, and reconnect HR professionals with their 'why'.
Niki Head
That session will be followed by Niki Head, people and development director at Stellar Entertainment, who'll be hosting a practical session titled
Challenge without conflict: how HR becomes a "critical friend" to leadership
. She will cover how HR can be elevated to becoming a trusted, influential strategic partner in leadership and boardroom settings, communicating challenging topics in a way that drives meaningful business results.
Other topics for presentations and breakout sessions include:
Insights into working effectively with trade unions
How to effectively support and manage neurodivergent staff
Creating strategies for workforce, leadership, and capability challenges created by the rising use of AI in the workplace
Practical insights into handling AI-generated casework in employee relations
The day will also include additional keynotes giving first-hand insight into how workplace culture drives organisational success. This will include insights from both HR business partners and C-suite execs on how an effective people strategy can support games businesses during times of extreme uncertainty, reflecting the ongoing challenges faced by so many organisations in recent years.
Our lineup has been guided by our panel of industry experts: Liz Prince MBE, business manager at Amiqus; Sarah Brewster, managing director at people and management consultancy
Fresh Seed
; Gina Jackson OBE, founder of coaching and skills agency Skillfull; and Emma Smith, founder of
Hestia Talent Partners
.
Further speakers and sessions will be confirmed in the coming days. Tickets
can be purchased here
.
